concerns.text: FR-001 mandates aggregation from 'Materials Project, NIST, OpenAlloy, published literature, and systematic literature review.' While T012d covers SLR/PDFs, tasks T012a (API fetch) and T012c (OpenAlloy) are marked as FAILED/missing artifacts in the analyze report. There is no active, executable task currently defined to fetch data from Materials Project or NIST APIs, leaving FR-001 partially unimplemented.

FR-001 and Constitution Principle II require verified sources. Task T009c (Populate sources.yaml) depends on T008b (Verify Research Sources), which is marked as FAILED/missing. Without a task to generate the verified source list or a fallback mechanism to define sources if verification fails, the ingestion pipeline (T012a/c/d) has no valid input, blocking FR-001 implementation.

FR-004 (XGBoost/Linear training), FR-005 (Bootstrap CIs), FR-006 (SHAP), FR-009 (Sensitivity), FR-013 (VIF), and SC-006 (Collinearity) rely on a chain of tasks (T024-T031c) that are all marked as unchecked/missing. Specifically, T024 (VIF), T025 (XGBoost), T026 (Linear), T028 (Bootstrap), T029c (Sensitivity), and T030 (SHAP) have no implementation tasks defined or are blocked by missing dependencies, leaving the core modeling requirements (US-002) unimplemented.

FR-003 (Descriptors) and US-003 (Visualizations) require scatter plots and partial dependence plots. Tasks T036 (Scatter), T037 (PDP), and T038 (Save plots) are unchecked. While T035 (Paper Draft) exists, the specific implementation tasks for generating the required visualizations (T036-T038) are missing, leaving SC-003 and SC-005 visualization requirements unmet.

Tasks T012a and T012c contain comments '<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->' and are marked as unchecked. These appear to be stale or broken task definitions from a previous iteration that were not properly resolved or removed. They should be either fixed to be executable or removed to avoid confusion.
